protocol: legacy v4, threshold-0.7 refinement; matched-frequency final evaluation
cost_formula: sum(P_l * d_l * w_l) / (32 * sum(P_l)); selected-layer scope; post-hoc weighting
aggregation: Arithmetic mean over nine model/budget rows per method; compute from unrounded values.
